label: Google Gemini CLI

skills.note: Gemini's own location. It also reads .agents/skills, but a tool gets its own directory: DAW never makes one tool depend on another's.

trust_note: Gemini fingerprints project hooks: if a hook's name or command changes (a git pull, for instance), it is treated as new and untrusted until you approve it again.

choice_prompt.note: the Ask User tool, `choice` type, with multiSelect
